records.name: Biology
records.summary: Biology investigates how living systems work, change, interact, and respond—from molecules and cells to organisms and ecosystems.
coreQuestions: How do cells maintain life?
How do genes and environments shape traits?
How do organisms and ecosystems change over time?
typicalWork: Write lab reports and scientific explanations
records.codingReality: Coding is not usually the center of a general biology major, but data analysis and computational tools increasingly appear in research and advanced courses.
rewarding: Connecting mechanisms across levels of life
Applying science to health or environment
frustrating: Experiments that fail or produce ambiguous results
Graduate education is common for independent research careers
mayEnjoy: Asking why living systems behave as they do

premedCompatibility.note: Many requirements overlap, but the major itself does not guarantee completion of every medical-school prerequisite.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Complete the UC A–G science requirement.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: If offered and sustainable, continue biology and chemistry and build quantitative confidence.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Try a short lab, ecology observation, genetics case, or research conversation.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Confirm each high-school course's A–G category on the official course list.

tryNow.title: Trace a DNA change to a protein and cell effect

records.name: Biochemistry
records.summary: Biochemistry studies the molecular reactions and structures that make life possible, connecting chemistry with cell biology and medicine.
coreQuestions: How do proteins and enzymes work?
How do cells store and use energy?
How can molecular changes lead to disease?
typicalWork: Reason about molecular structure and reactions
Interpret spectra, assays, and experimental data
records.codingReality: Programming is not usually central, but computation is increasingly used for molecular modeling, genomics, and laboratory data.
rewarding: Explaining health and disease at a molecular level

premedCompatibility.note: Substantial prerequisite overlap is common, but requirements vary by medical school.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Complete UC A–G laboratory science requirements.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue chemistry and mathematics if available and sustainable; biology is also useful.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Model enzyme behavior or investigate how pH affects a biological system.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Verify A–G certification and senior-course prerequisites.

tryNow.title: Explore carbon dioxide and the blood buffer system

records.name: Data Science
records.summary: Data science combines statistics, programming, data management, and domain knowledge to draw defensible conclusions from data.
coreQuestions: What can the data support?
How uncertain is a conclusion?
How can messy information become a useful model?
typicalWork: Build and evaluate statistical or machine-learning models
records.codingReality: Meaningful programming is a core part of most data-science degrees and jobs. AI can assist with code, but students still need to understand, test, debug, and defend analyses.
frustrating: Pressure to explain uncertainty to people who want a simple answer
mayEnjoy: Using evidence across biology, health, business, or policy

premedCompatibility.note: It can build valuable quantitative skills, but science laboratories and other prerequisites often require additional scheduling.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Meet UC A–G mathematics requirements; coding is not a systemwide UC eligibility requirement.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue mathematics and, if willing, try a small data analysis using a beginner-friendly language or spreadsheet.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Analyze a small health or biology dataset and explain one limitation.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Check whether a campus admits directly to the major and whether switching is constrained.

tryNow.title: Compare two explanations for a small health dataset

records.name: Statistics
records.summary: Statistics develops methods for learning from variable and incomplete data while measuring uncertainty.
coreQuestions: How should evidence be collected?
What pattern could be chance?
How confident should a conclusion be?
records.codingReality: Statistical computing is common. The emphasis is usually on analysis and reasoning rather than building software products.
rewarding: Working across medicine, science, policy, and business
frustrating: Results that remain uncertain after careful work

premedCompatibility.note: Statistics supports research and evidence literacy; laboratory science prerequisites must be scheduled separately.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Meet UC A–G mathematics requirements using courses certified for the applicable term.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue mathematics through the strongest sustainable sequence available.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Critique a study or design a fair experiment.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Because UC math-course classification guidance changes, verify the school's certified course list.

tryNow.title: Spot bias in a study design

records.name: Cognitive Science
records.summary: Cognitive science studies mind and intelligence using psychology, neuroscience, linguistics, philosophy, computation, and experimental methods.
coreQuestions: How do people perceive, learn, remember, and decide?
How can mental processes be tested?
How do people interact with technology?
records.codingReality: Coding varies by track. Computational cognition and data-heavy research can involve substantial programming; human-centered tracks may involve less.
rewarding: Multiple ways to approach one question
frustrating: Some career paths require graduate training
mayEnjoy: Research with human participants or behavior data

premedCompatibility.note: Behavioral and neuroscience courses may be relevant, but chemistry, physics, biology, and laboratory prerequisites require deliberate scheduling.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: No cognitive-science-specific course is a systemwide UC eligibility requirement.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue mathematics; biology, psychology, writing, or computer science can each be useful depending on the track.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Run a simple memory or perception study without collecting identifying data.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Compare BA and BS requirements and campus-specific admission context.

records.name: Public Health
records.summary: Public health improves the health of populations through prevention, evidence, community partnership, policy, and health systems.
coreQuestions: Why do health outcomes differ across groups and places?
Which prevention strategy works?
How should limited resources be used?
records.codingReality: Coding varies. Epidemiology and biostatistics tracks can use R, Python, SAS, or similar tools; policy and community tracks may use less.
rewarding: Working across science, policy, and community needs
frustrating: Entry roles vary and graduate education is common for specialized work

premedCompatibility.note: The major offers useful population-health perspective, but medical-school science prerequisites may not all be included.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Meet the general UC A–G requirements; public health has no systemwide high-school prerequisite.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Build biology, statistics, writing, and social-science skills within a sustainable schedule.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Investigate a local health pattern using public, non-identifying data.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Some campus public-health majors require later application or are selective; verify the current policy.

tryNow.title: Choose evidence for a fictional prevention program

records.name: Bioengineering
records.summary: Bioengineering applies engineering, mathematics, computing, and biology to devices, diagnostics, therapeutics, and biological systems.
coreQuestions: How can a device measure or support the body?
How can biological systems be modeled or redesigned?
How do safety and design tradeoffs interact?
records.codingReality: Most programs include some programming or computational modeling, although it is one tool among mathematics, physical science, biology, and design.
frustrating: Design must satisfy safety, cost, regulatory, and technical constraints

premedCompatibility.note: It can prepare students well scientifically, but the engineering workload and medical-school prerequisites require careful planning.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Meet UC A–G requirements; campus engineering admission policies may differ.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue mathematics, chemistry, biology, and physics when available and sustainable.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Redesign a simple health-monitoring device around a user need.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: Verify direct-admission and change-of-major constraints before using an alternate-major strategy.

tryNow.title: Compare two sensor designs for a fictional patient need

records.name: Operations Research and Systems Analytics
records.summary: Operations research uses mathematical models, optimization, simulation, and data to improve decisions in complex systems.
coreQuestions: How should scarce resources be allocated?
What schedule or route works best?
How robust is a decision when conditions change?
records.codingReality: Programming is commonly used to solve models and analyze scenarios, but the role centers on decisions and systems rather than software development.
rewarding: Applications in healthcare, transport, supply chains, policy, and business

premedCompatibility.note: The major can support healthcare systems work, but premed laboratory sciences are usually outside the core.

highSchoolPreparation.label: uc_eligibility_requirement
highSchoolPreparation.text: Meet UC A–G mathematics requirements.

highSchoolPreparation.label: recommended_academic_preparation
highSchoolPreparation.text: Continue mathematics and practice translating real situations into constraints and tradeoffs.

highSchoolPreparation.label: optional_exploration
highSchoolPreparation.text: Optimize a fictional clinic schedule with competing goals.

highSchoolPreparation.label: verify_with_counselor_or_institution
highSchoolPreparation.text: The field may appear under industrial engineering, analytics, applied mathematics, or management science; compare exact curricula.
